result.summary: Found several layout/content issues including cut-off cards at the screen edge, truncated text, and inconsistent card styling in the horizontal scroll sections.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccolo) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, indicating the horizontal scroll view is not clearly indicating scrollability
issues.suggestion: Add a partial peek or fade gradient to indicate more content is scrollable, or ensure consistent card widths that don't abruptly cut off

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated, likely cut off as 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar longer name
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses ellipsis (...) consistently or increase card width to fit full name

issues.description: Heart/favorite icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white/outline while the one on the pizza card below is dark filled circle, creating inconsistent icon styling across similar cards
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon style and color across all promotional cards for visual consistency

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the bottom is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible restaurant name or details
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient padding/margin above the navigation bar so cards are not visually cut off, or add scroll indication

issues.description: Small red notification dot on profile avatar icon (top right) has no visible label or count, making it unclear what it represents
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label or tooltip describing the notification, and consider showing a count if applicable
